metadata.label: Graubünden · initial rail, bus and cableway study
metadata.scope: Every annual GTFS trip with at least one source stop inside the complete official Graubünden polygon, across every agency and mode. Fixture trips retain every source call, including cross-canton termini. No straight-line crossing test for nonstopping through traffic.
exclusions: Entire annual national GTFS canton-calling inventory; not services absent from GTFS or nonstopping through traffic.
Friday and Sunday in September do not validate winter, holidays, ski shuttles or all seasonal patterns.
Official local line geometry not admitted: current export, route crosswalk and dataset-specific reuse terms remain unverified.
Infrastructure vintage and OSM routing do not certify September 2026 service itineraries, track assignment or temporary diversions.
metadata.note: Every ordered pair must pass within its complete directed pattern. No conditional calls, cropped journeys or unreviewed modes. Paths are inferred, not observed.
metadata.model: Timetable interpolation on reviewed rail infrastructure and inferred OSM bus paths, with selected reviewed federal cableway and funicular axes. Frequency services are representative headway movement, not exact departures or observed cabins.
